model.description: Semantic-drift guard, axis-2 of R37.34 (7698c63b, child of R37.3). R37.3's fail-loud pin==board==files byte-check is BLIND to task<->req AC drift: T37.20's task-md rendered 6 ACs while its covered req R37.20 had 7, and S37 still BYTE-MATCHED (the architect miscounted from the view, req was right from the unit). model.intention: A task's rendered ACs (task-md) always equal its covering requirement's ACs — count AND ids — or the board goes RED. Semantic parity, not byte-identity.
